# Plots Simulation Study

## theta1 = theta2 = 0.4, rho_B = 0.8, rho_W = 0.8, p_i = 0.2, n_sim = 1900, M = 200, delta_sim = delta_est, variance and tau estimated

```{r}
res_simstudy <- read.csv2("Data/Sim_summary/data_simulation_main_scenario_2026_09_22.csv", sep = ",")

# turn data into long format for simulation parameters
theta04_long <- res_simstudy %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^(Bias|MSE|Coverage|CI_Width)_"), 
               names_to = c(".value", "method"),
               names_pattern = "^(Bias|MSE|Coverage|CI_Width)_(.*)")

# add I2 variable
theta04_long <- theta04_long %>%
  mutate(I2 = case_when(tau2_val == 0.00 ~ "0",
                        tau2_val == 0.02 ~ "30",
                        tau2_val == 0.06 ~ "60",
                        tau2_val == 0.36 ~ "90",
                        TRUE             ~ NA_character_))

# make sure all variables are numeric
theta04_long <- theta04_long %>%
  mutate(across(c(K, theta_1, theta_2, tau2_val, rho_b, rho_w, delta_sim, p1, delta_est,
                  Avg_Redraws, Bias, MSE, Coverage, CI_Width, I2), as.numeric))
```


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
theta04_plot <- theta04_long %>%
  filter(select_type %in% c("zscore", "effect"),
         method %in% c("Naive_Biv", "Adj_Biv", "Full", "Adj_Uni")) %>%
  mutate(select_type = factor(select_type,
                              levels = c("zscore", "effect"),
                              labels = c("Selection on\nz-score",
                                         "Selection on\ntreatment effect")))

# check the actual bias range per I2 level to choose sensible limits
theta04_plot %>%
  group_by(I2) %>%
  summarise(min_bias = min(Bias, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_bias = max(Bias, na.rm = TRUE))

# y-axis limits and tick spacing per I2 level (adjust after checking the table above)
y_settings <- list("0"  = list(lim = c(-0.03, 0.04), by = 0.02),
                   "30" = list(lim = c(-0.03, 0.06), by = 0.02),
                   "60" = list(lim = c(-0.03, 0.08), by = 0.02),
                   "90" = list(lim = c(-0.05, 0.22), by = 0.10))

plot_bias_i2 <- function(i2_level,
                         data = theta04_plot,
                         settings = y_settings) {
  
  ylim_i2 <- settings[[i2_level]]$lim
  ybreak  <- settings[[i2_level]]$by
  
  ggplot(filter(data, I2 == i2_level),
         aes(x = delta_est, y = Bias, color = method)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = method), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_grid(select_type ~ K,
               labeller = labeller(K = as_labeller(function(x) paste0("K == ", x),
                                                   default = label_parsed))) +
    labs(x = expression("Selection Weight"~delta),
         y = "Bias") +
    scale_color_manual(name = " ",
                       values = c("Full"      = "#000000",
                                  "Naive_Biv" = "#0072B2",
                                  "Adj_Uni"   = "#D55E00",
                                  "Adj_Biv"   = "#009E73"),
                       labels = c("Full"      = "Complete Data",
                                  "Naive_Biv" = "Naive",
                                  "Adj_Uni"   = "Univariate",
                                  "Adj_Biv"   = "Bivariate")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.1, 0.3, by = ybreak)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_i2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(# larger gap between the two selection rows within one I2 block
          panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
          # smaller gap between the I2 blocks: less top/bottom margin per plot
          plot.margin = margin(t = 14, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10),
          axis.title   = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
          strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 16))
}

i2_levels <- c("0", "30", "60", "90")
plots_i2  <- lapply(i2_levels, plot_bias_i2)

ggarrange(plotlist = plots_i2,
          common.legend = TRUE,
          legend = "bottom",
          nrow = 4, ncol = 1,
          labels = paste0(LETTERS[1:4], "  I\u00B2 = ", i2_levels, "%"),
          hjust = 0,
          font.label = list(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          label.y = 1.0)

ggsave("Plots_Paper/SimStudy_Bias.png", width = 10, height = 12)
```

### Analyse numerical stability parameters

```{r, echo = FALSE}
stability <- res_simstudy %>%
  dplyr::select(scenario_idx,
                K,
                tau2_val,
                rho_b,
                rho_w,
                delta_sim,
                p1,
                select_type,
                delta_est,
                
                Prop_Redrawn,
                Avg_Redraws,
                Max_Redraws,
                
                Failure_Rate_Full,
                Failure_Rate_Naive,
                Failure_Rate_Uni,
                Failure_Rate_Biv,
                
                Mean_Complete_Pairs,
                Mean_Failed_Imputations_Uni,
                Mean_Failed_Imputations_Biv)

stability <- stability %>%
  dplyr::mutate(I2 = dplyr::case_when(tau2_val == 0    ~ 0,
                                      tau2_val == 0.02 ~ 0.30,
                                      tau2_val == 0.06 ~ 0.60,
                                      tau2_val == 0.36 ~ 0.90,
                                      TRUE ~ NA_real_))

# make sure all variables are numeric
stability <- stability %>%
  mutate(across(c(tau2_val, rho_b, rho_w, delta_sim, p1, delta_est,
                  Avg_Redraws, Prop_Redrawn, Max_Redraws, Failure_Rate_Full, 
                  Failure_Rate_Naive, Failure_Rate_Uni, Failure_Rate_Biv,
                  Mean_Complete_Pairs, Mean_Failed_Imputations_Biv,
                  Mean_Failed_Imputations_Uni), as.numeric))

stability_K_I2 <- stability %>%
  dplyr::group_by(K, I2) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Prop_Redrawn = mean(Prop_Redrawn, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Avg_Redraws = mean(Avg_Redraws, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Full = mean(Failure_Rate_Full, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Naive = mean(Failure_Rate_Naive, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Uni = mean(Failure_Rate_Uni, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Biv = mean(Failure_Rate_Biv, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(stability_K_I2)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
ggplot(stability_K_I2, aes(x = I2, y = Prop_Redrawn, group = factor(K),
                           linetype = factor(K))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9), 
                     labels = c("0%", "30%", "60%", "90%")) +
  labs(x = expression(I^2), y = "Proportion of repetitions requiring redraw",
       linetype = "Number of studies (K)") +
  theme_minimal()
```




###  Repetition-wise deletion theta1 = theta2 = 0.4, rho_B = 0.8, rho_W = 0.8, p_i = 0.2, n_sim = 1900, M = 200, delta_sim = delta_est, variance and tau estimated


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
theta04_plot <- theta04_long %>%
  filter(select_type %in% c("zscore", "effect"),
         method %in% c("Naive_Common", "Adj_Biv_Common", "Full_Common",
                       "Adj_Uni_Common")) %>%

                   "60" = list(lim = c(-0.03, 0.08), by = 0.02),
                   "90" = list(lim = c(-0.05, 0.22), by = 0.10))

                             data = theta04_plot,
                             settings = y_settings) {

  ybreak  <- settings[[i2_level]]$by
  
  ggplot(filter(data, I2 == i2_level),
         aes(x = delta_est, y = Bias, color = method)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = method), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_grid(select_type ~ K,
               labeller = labeller(

                                 default = label_parsed))) +
    labs(x = expression("Selection Weight"~delta),
         y = "Bias") +
    scale_color_manual(name = " ",
                   values = c("Full_Common"      = "#000000",
                              "Naive_Common"     = "#0072B2",
                              "Adj_Uni_Common"   = "#D55E00",

                              "Naive_Common"     = "Naive",
                              "Adj_Uni_Common"   = "Univariate",
                              "Adj_Biv_Common"   = "Bivariate")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.1, 0.3, by = ybreak)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_i2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(# larger gap between the two selection rows within one I2 block
          panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
          # smaller gap between the I2 blocks: less top/bottom margin per plot
          plot.margin = margin(t = 14, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10),
          axis.title   = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
          strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 16))
}

ggarrange(plotlist = plots_i2,
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
theta04_plot %>%
  group_by(I2) %>%
  summarise(min_Cov = min(Coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_Cov = max(Coverage, na.rm = TRUE))

# y-axis limits and tick spacing per I2 level (adjust after checking the table above)
y_settings <- list("0"  = list(lim = c(0.88, 1), by = 0.05),
                   "30" = list(lim = c(0.82, 1), by = 0.05),
                   "60" = list(lim = c(0.79, 1), by = 0.05),
                   "90" = list(lim = c(0.56, 1), by = 0.1))

plot_Cov_i2_Rep <- function(i2_level, 
                            data = theta04_plot, 
                            settings = y_settings) {
  
  ylim_i2 <- settings[[i2_level]]$lim
  ybreak  <- settings[[i2_level]]$by
  
  ggplot(filter(data, I2 == i2_level),
         aes(x = delta_est, y = Coverage, color = method)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = method), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_grid(select_type ~ K,
               labeller = labeller(
                 K = as_labeller(function(x) paste0("K == ", x),
                                 default = label_parsed))) +
    labs(x = expression("Selection Weight"~delta),
         y = "Coverage") +
   scale_color_manual(name = " ",
                      values = c("Full_Common"      = "#000000",
                                 "Naive_Common"     = "#0072B2",
                                 "Adj_Uni_Common"   = "#D55E00",
                                 "Adj_Biv_Common"   = "#009E73"),
                      labels = c("Full_Common"      = "Complete Data",
                                 "Naive_Common"     = "Naive",
                                 "Adj_Uni_Common"   = "Univariate",
                                 "Adj_Biv_Common"   = "Bivariate")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = ybreak)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_i2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(# larger gap between the two selection rows within one I2 block
          panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
          # smaller gap between the I2 blocks: less top/bottom margin per plot
          plot.margin = margin(t = 14, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10),
          axis.title   = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
          strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 16))
}

plots_i2  <- lapply(i2_levels, plot_Cov_i2_Rep)

ggarrange(plotlist = plots_i2,
          common.legend = TRUE,
          legend = "bottom",
          nrow = 4, ncol = 1,
          labels = paste0(LETTERS[1:4], "  I\u00B2 = ", i2_levels, "%"),
          hjust = 0,
          font.label = list(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          label.y = 1.01)

ggsave("Plots_Paper/SimStudy_Coverage_RepDel.png", width = 10, height = 12)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
repetition_wise <- res_simstudy %>%
  dplyr::select(scenario_idx,
                K,
                tau2_val,
                rho_b,
                rho_w,
                delta_sim,
                p1,
                select_type,
                delta_est,
                
                N_Eligible,
                N_Common,
                Prop_Common)

repetition_wise <- repetition_wise %>%
  dplyr::mutate(I2 = dplyr::case_when(tau2_val == 0    ~ 0,
                                      tau2_val == 0.02 ~ 0.30,
                                      tau2_val == 0.06 ~ 0.60,
                                      tau2_val == 0.36 ~ 0.90,
                                      TRUE ~ NA_real_),
                Attrition_Rate = 1 - as.numeric(Prop_Common))

repetition_wise <- repetition_wise %>%
  mutate(across(c(tau2_val, rho_b, rho_w, delta_sim, p1, delta_est,
                  N_Eligible, N_Common, Prop_Common, Attrition_Rate), as.numeric))

repetition_wise_K_I2 <- repetition_wise %>%
  dplyr::group_by(K, I2) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Mean_N_Common      = mean(N_Common, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Mean_Prop_Common    = mean(Prop_Common, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Mean_Attrition_Rate = mean(Attrition_Rate, na.rm = TRUE),
                  .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(repetition_wise_K_I2)
```

### Analyse numerical stability parameters

```{r}
stability <- res_simstudy %>%
  dplyr::select(scenario_idx,
                K,
                tau2_val,
                rho_b,
                rho_w,
                delta_sim,
                p1,
                select_type,
                delta_est,
                
                Prop_Redrawn,
                Avg_Redraws,
                Max_Redraws,
                
                Failure_Rate_Full,
                Failure_Rate_Naive,
                Failure_Rate_Uni,
                Failure_Rate_Biv,
                
                Mean_Complete_Pairs,
                Mean_Failed_Imputations_Uni,
                Mean_Failed_Imputations_Biv)

stability <- stability %>%
  dplyr::mutate(I2 = dplyr::case_when(tau2_val == 0    ~ 0,
                                      tau2_val == 0.02 ~ 0.30,
                                      tau2_val == 0.06 ~ 0.60,
                                      tau2_val == 0.36 ~ 0.90,
                                      TRUE ~ NA_real_))

# make sure all variables are numeric
stability <- stability %>%
  mutate(across(c(tau2_val, rho_b, rho_w, delta_sim, p1, delta_est,
                  Avg_Redraws, Prop_Redrawn, Max_Redraws, Failure_Rate_Full, 
                  Failure_Rate_Naive, Failure_Rate_Uni, Failure_Rate_Biv,
                  Mean_Complete_Pairs, Mean_Failed_Imputations_Biv,
                  Mean_Failed_Imputations_Uni), as.numeric))

stability_K_I2 <- stability %>%
  dplyr::group_by(K, I2) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Prop_Redrawn = mean(Prop_Redrawn, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Avg_Redraws = mean(Avg_Redraws, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Full = mean(Failure_Rate_Full, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Naive = mean(Failure_Rate_Naive, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Uni = mean(Failure_Rate_Uni, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Biv = mean(Failure_Rate_Biv, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(stability_K_I2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(stability_K_I2, aes(x = I2, y = Prop_Redrawn, group = factor(K),
                           linetype = factor(K))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9),
                     labels = c("0%", "30%", "60%", "90%")) +
  labs(x = expression(I^2), y = "Proportion of repetitions requiring redraw",
       linetype = "Number of studies (K)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
                  Mean_Complete_Pairs, Mean_Failed_Imputations_Biv,
                  Mean_Failed_Imputations_Uni), as.numeric))

                   Avg_Redraws = mean(Avg_Redraws, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Full = mean(Failure_Rate_Full, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Naive = mean(Failure_Rate_Naive, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Uni = mean(Failure_Rate_Uni, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Biv = mean(Failure_Rate_Biv, na.rm = TRUE),

knitr::kable(stability_K_I2)
```

```{r}
  dplyr::select(scenario_idx,
                K,
                tau2_val,
                rho_b,
                rho_w,
                delta_sim,
                p1,
                select_type,
                delta_est,
                
                Prop_Redrawn,
                Avg_Redraws,
                Max_Redraws,
                
                Failure_Rate_Full,
                Failure_Rate_Naive,
                Failure_Rate_Uni,
                Failure_Rate_Biv,
                
                Mean_Complete_Pairs,
                Mean_Failed_Imputations_Uni,
                Mean_Failed_Imputations_Biv)

stability <- stability %>%
  dplyr::mutate(I2 = dplyr::case_when(tau2_val == 0    ~ 0,
                                      tau2_val == 0.02 ~ 0.30,
                                      tau2_val == 0.06 ~ 0.60,
                                      tau2_val == 0.36 ~ 0.90,
                                      TRUE ~ NA_real_))

# make sure all variables are numeric
stability <- stability %>%
  mutate(across(c(tau2_val, rho_b, rho_w, delta_sim, p1, delta_est,
                  Avg_Redraws, Prop_Redrawn, Max_Redraws, Failure_Rate_Full, 
                  Failure_Rate_Naive, Failure_Rate_Uni, Failure_Rate_Biv,
                  Mean_Complete_Pairs, Mean_Failed_Imputations_Biv,
                  Mean_Failed_Imputations_Uni), as.numeric))

stabilityp02 <- subset(stability, p1 == "0.2")

stability_K_I2 <- stabilityp02 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(K, I2) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Prop_Redrawn = mean(Prop_Redrawn, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Avg_Redraws = mean(Avg_Redraws, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Full = mean(Failure_Rate_Full, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Naive = mean(Failure_Rate_Naive, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Uni = mean(Failure_Rate_Uni, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Failure_Biv = mean(Failure_Rate_Biv, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(stability_K_I2)
```


# Proxy for $\rho_W$

## theta1 = theta2 = 0.4, K = 25, p_i = 0.2, n_sim = 1900, M = 200, delta_sim = delta_est = (0, 0.5 1), variance and tau estimated

```{r}

res_simstudy <- read.csv2("Data/Sim_summary/data_simulation_rho_w_proxy_2026-10-08.csv", sep = ",")

proxy_long <- res_simstudy %>%
  filter(select_type %in% c("zscore", "effect")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^(Bias|Coverage)_Adj_Biv(_Oracle|_Swapped)?$"),
               names_to = c(".value", "method"),
               names_pattern = "^(Bias|Coverage)_(.*)$") 

proxy_long <- type.convert(proxy_long, as.is = TRUE)

proxy_long <- proxy_long %>%
  mutate(method  = factor(method, levels = c("Adj_Biv", "Adj_Biv_Oracle",  
                                             "Adj_Biv_Swapped")),
         rho_lab = paste0("rho[W]==", rho_w, "~~rho[B]==", rho_b),
         I2 = case_when(tau2_val == 0.00 ~ "0",
                               tau2_val == 0.02 ~ "30",
                               tau2_val == 0.06 ~ "60",
                               tau2_val == 0.36 ~ "90",
                               TRUE             ~ NA_character_))

proxy_long <- proxy_long %>%
   mutate(select_type = factor(select_type,
                               levels = c("zscore", "effect"),
                               labels = c("Selection on\nz-score",
                                          "Selection on\ntreatment effect")))

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}

plot_proxy <- function(i2_level,
                       metric = c("Bias", "Coverage"),
                       data   = proxy_long,
                       ylim   = NULL) {
  metric <- match.arg(metric)
  ref    <- if (metric == "Coverage") 0.95 else 0

  ggplot(filter(data, I2 == i2_level),
         aes(x = delta_est, y = .data[[metric]],
             color = method, linetype = method, shape = method)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ref, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_line(aes(group = method), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    facet_grid(select_type ~ rho_lab,
               labeller = labeller(rho_lab = label_parsed,
                                   select_type = label_value)) +
    labs(x = expression("Selection Weight"~delta), y = metric) +
    scale_color_manual(name = " ",
      values = c("Adj_Biv" = "#009E73", "Adj_Biv_Oracle" = "#56B4E9",
                 "Adj_Biv_Swapped" = "#CC79A7"),
      labels = c("Adj_Biv" = "Pearson proxy",
                 "Adj_Biv_Oracle" = expression("True"~rho[W]),
                 "Adj_Biv_Swapped" = expression("Swapped ("*rho[B]*")"))) +
    scale_linetype_manual(name = " ",
      values = c("Adj_Biv" = "solid", "Adj_Biv_Oracle" = "dashed",
                 "Adj_Biv_Swapped" = "dotted"),
      labels = c("Adj_Biv" = "Pearson proxy",
                 "Adj_Biv_Oracle" = expression("True"~rho[W]),
                 "Adj_Biv_Swapped" = expression("Swapped ("*rho[B]*")"))) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = " ",
      values = c("Adj_Biv" = 16, "Adj_Biv_Oracle" = 17, "Adj_Biv_Swapped" = 15),
      labels = c("Adj_Biv" = "Pearson proxy",
                 "Adj_Biv_Oracle" = expression("True"~rho[W]),
                 "Adj_Biv_Swapped" = expression("Swapped ("*rho[B]*")"))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 14, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
          strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 16))
}

plots_i2  <- lapply(i2_levels, plot_proxy)

ggarrange(plotlist = plots_i2,
          common.legend = TRUE,
          legend = "bottom",
          nrow = 4, ncol = 1,
          labels = paste0(LETTERS[1:4], "  I\u00B2 = ", i2_levels, "%"),
          hjust = 0,
          font.label = list(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          label.y = 1.0)

ggsave("Plots_Paper/Supp_SimStudy_Bias_proxy.png", width = 10, height = 12)
```

```{r}
rho_long <- res_simstudy %>%
  filter(delta_est == 1) %>%    # strongest selection; drop if you want all δ
  select(tau2_val, rho_w, rho_b, select_type, Mean_Rho_Hat, Mean_Rho_Hat_Full) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("Mean_Rho"), names_to = "which", values_to = "rho") %>%
  mutate(which   = recode(which, Mean_Rho_Hat = "After ORB",
                                 Mean_Rho_Hat_Full = "Complete data"),
         rho_lab = paste0("rho[W]==", rho_w, "~~rho[B]==", rho_b))

rho_long <- type.convert(rho_long, as.is = TRUE)

rho_long <- rho_long %>%
   mutate(select_type = factor(select_type,
                               levels = c("zscore", "effect"),
                               labels = c("Selection on\nz-score",
                                          "Selection on\ntreatment effect")))


# approximate variance-weighted mixture (within variance 2/n_arm = 0.04)
theory <- distinct(rho_long, rho_w, rho_b, rho_lab) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(tau2_val = seq(0, 0.36, length.out = 100)) %>%
  mutate(rho = (rho_b * tau2_val + rho_w * 0.04) / (tau2_val + 0.04))

ggplot(rho_long, aes(tau2_val, rho, color = which)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = rho_w), data = distinct(rho_long, rho_w, rho_lab),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = rho_b), data = distinct(rho_long, rho_b, rho_lab),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) + geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_grid(select_type ~ rho_lab, 
             labeller = labeller(rho_lab = label_parsed,
                                 select_type = label_value)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.02, 0.06, 0.36), 
                     labels = c("0", "0.02", "0.06", "0.36"), 
                     guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)) +
  labs(x = expression(tau^2), y = "Mean Pearson proxy", color = " ") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",   
        strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
       panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())

ggsave("Plots_Paper/Supp_SimStudy_proxy.png", width = 6, height = 4)
```
